description: This file defines the FindByAnd class which implements an entity operation for performing a conditional 'find' in the Apache OFBiz framework's mini-lang language. It processes an XML element to set up the find parameters, executes the query with specified conditions, and provides related metadata.

classes.name: FindByAnd
classes.description: Implements an entity operation for executing a filtered entity lookup based on 'AND' conditions in the OFBiz mini-lang framework.

classes.name: FindByAndFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of FindByAnd from XML element configurations.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the entity find operation based on initialized parameters, filtering by conditions and optionally using cache and iterator, storing results in the method context.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information such as entity name used for dependency analysis.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the FindByAnd element with its attributes.
